preToolUse.prompt: Hard policy gate for file edits. NEVER allow an edit that changes, reinterprets, or replaces behavior the human has described in this conversation (or a product rule they stated), unless they explicitly approved that exact behavior in this conversation. Also DENY OpenSpec/spec/design/tasks writes that pick a new product rule when the human's stated rule conflicts and they have not chosen yet. ALLOW when the human already approved this change, the edit restores human-stated behavior, the edit is non-semantic, or no human-described product behavior is at stake. If unsure: DENY and tell the agent to propose, describe options, and ask the human. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
